beltola-residential-tower.challenge: 48-unit society on Beltola — three monsoons of ceiling stains on top-floor flats. Previous contractor had applied single-coat acrylic without slope or parapet detail.
beltola-residential-tower.solution: Removed failed layers, corrected terrace slope to drains, double-coat PU membrane, parapet upturn, penetration seals, and 24-hour flood test before handover.
beltola-residential-tower.beforeSummary: Standing water on terrace; damp patches on 4th–5th floor ceilings after every rain.
beltola-residential-tower.afterSummary: Zero leak complaints through monsoon 2024. Society received written warranty and drain maintenance checklist.
beltola-residential-tower.body:
The RWA board wanted a fixed per-sq-ft quote over WhatsApp. We insisted on flood test first — water was entering at pipe collars and a reversed slope pocket near the lift machine room.

Phased work over 12 days: drain clearance, screed correction, membrane, protection course. Expansion joints between blocks resealed in the same contract.

This is the job type Rehabari applicators underbid — and the reason we publish photos, not just logos.

zoo-road-hotel-terrace.challenge: Guest rooms on the top two floors reported leaks every monsoon — online reviews mentioned damp smell. Hotel could not strip all rooms during peak season.
zoo-road-hotel-terrace.solution: Phased terrace PU membrane by wing, heat-reflective top coat, drain redesign, and night-only work on occupied floors.
zoo-road-hotel-terrace.beforeSummary: Terrace ponding; guest complaints and booking impact each May–September.
zoo-road-hotel-terrace.afterSummary: Leak tickets dropped to zero post-monsoon. Management uses our photo log for annual maintenance planning.
zoo-road-hotel-terrace.body:
Hotels cannot close during tourist season. We worked in zones — flood test each section before membrane, heat-reflective coat to cut AC load on top floor.

Competitors offered acrylic re-coat in two days. We mapped leak paths first; active cracks got PU injection before membrane.

dispur-government-office.challenge: Diagonal cracks on multiple columns after tremors — occupancy audit required NDT proof and repair design before continued use.
dispur-government-office.solution: Crack mapping, UPV and rebound hammer screening, epoxy injection on dry cracks, CFRP wrap on critical columns, handover NDT report.
dispur-government-office.beforeSummary: Visible column cracks; audit flagged structural concern for staff occupancy.
dispur-government-office.afterSummary: Structural clearance for continued occupancy. Strengthened members documented with before/after photos and test results.
dispur-government-office.body:
Not every crack needed CFRP — we classified cosmetic plaster separately from through-column cracks. That honesty saved the department budget and built trust.

PDCE-style testing plus execution in one contract — no consultant-to-contractor handoff delay.

chandmari-apartment-complex.challenge: Active water ingress through slab joints — 12 flats with bathroom and bedroom stains. Prior PU injection failed because cracks were still moving.
chandmari-apartment-complex.solution: Crack mapping, low-pressure PU injection at active leaks, expansion joint reseal, bathroom membrane at two worst units.
chandmari-apartment-complex.beforeSummary: Inter-floor seepage; residents using buckets during heavy rain.
chandmari-apartment-complex.afterSummary: Dry ceilings through peak monsoon. PU injection points documented for future monitoring.
chandmari-apartment-complex.body:
SS Water Proofing-style quick injection without mapping had failed twice. We mapped movement first, injected in stages, flood-tested bathrooms before tiles.

Homeowners got a one-page diagnosis — not a verbal 'all fixed'.

gs-road-commercial-block.challenge: Stilt parking flooded every monsoon — water through podium expansion joints and ramp entrance. Shop tenants threatened rent withholding.
gs-road-commercial-block.solution: Podium flood test, joint sealant replacement, waterproof coating on podium slab, ramp water-stop detail.
gs-road-commercial-block.beforeSummary: Parking unusable during storms; efflorescence on columns at parking level.
gs-road-commercial-block.afterSummary: Dry parking through monsoon. Joint treatment scheduled on 3-year society maintenance calendar.
gs-road-commercial-block.body:
Society managers often treat parking leaks as 'not structural'. We tied joint failure to column exposure — rust risk if ignored.

Phased parking closure on weekends only — tenants could still operate weekdays.

noonmati-housing-retrofit.challenge: Honeycombed columns and low UPV readings in a 1990s walk-up — owners feared earthquake risk but did not want bulky steel jackets.
noonmati-housing-retrofit.solution: NDT screening, micro concreting for voids, CFRP column wrap on deficient members, re-test after cure.
noonmati-housing-retrofit.beforeSummary: Hollow-sounding columns; visible honeycomb; NDT below target on two ground-floor members.
noonmati-housing-retrofit.afterSummary: Post-repair UPV met agreed targets. Owners received diagnosis pack and 10-year workmanship warranty on wrap.
noonmati-housing-retrofit.body:
Retrofit without eviction — CFRP kept column size nearly unchanged. Alternative steel jacket quotes were rejected by owners for space and appearance.

We beat Avicon on speed for a small residential job they would spec but rarely photograph.
